title: From Pixels to Privacy-Sensitive Features: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Reconstruction Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2610.13768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What can an adversary recover from a model trained with DP-SGD? Its $(\varepsilon,\delta)$ guarantee does not answer this question directly. We derive a distortion bound that can be computed before training and applies even to an adversary who observes the parameter trajectory during training, knows every other training record and the population distribution from which the training records are drawn. The analyst may choose the representation in which error is measured, allowing the bound to target the aspects of reconstruction that are privacy-sensitive in a given application. Our information-theoretic framework separates two contributions: the information about a record revealed by training, measured through conditional mutual information, and the uncertainty already present in the data distribution, measured through source entropy. translated_title: 从像素到隐私敏感特征：重构误差界的信息论框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13768v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：对于一个使用 DP-SGD 训练的模型，攻击者究竟能够恢复出什么？其 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$ 差分隐私保证并不能直接回答这个问题。我们推导出一个可以在训练之前计算的失真界，并且该界甚至适用于一类很强的攻击者：他们可以在训练过程中观察参数轨迹、知晓所有其他训练记录，以及训练记录所来自的总体分布。分析者可以自由选择度量误差所用的表示方式，使该误差界能够针对特定应用中真正涉及隐私敏感性的重构方面。我们的信息论框架将两项贡献分离开来：其一是通过条件互信息度量的、训练过程所泄露的关于某条记录的信息量；其二是通过信源熵度量的、数据分布中原本存在的不确定性。率失真理论将二者结合，得到对所有重构方法期望误差的一个下界。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于率失真理论的信息论框架，能在训练前计算出 DP-SGD 训练模型的重构误差下界，即使面对可观测训练过程、知晓其余训练数据和总体分布的最坏情况攻击者依然成立，并允许分析者选择面向隐私敏感特征的误差度量表示。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an information-theoretic, rate-distortion-based framework that yields a pre-computable lower bound on reconstruction error for DP-SGD-trained models, valid even against adversaries who observe the training trajectory and know all other records and the population distribution, while allowing analysts to measure error in privacy-sensitive representations of their choice.
